packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates. The full CI build + the required Chromatic 'UI Tests' status check are the gate: patch/minor bumps (and the digest/pin bumps that pinning generates) land unattended only when the app still builds, behaves, and looks pixel-identical. See ADR-0017.

Major updates always land by hand. A green gate proves 'still works and looks the same', which a major (React 19->20, Tailwind 4->5, a Radix major) can pass while changing API/behaviour semantics no pixel diff reveals.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: CVE fixes bypass the 14-day age gate and the Wednesday schedule (both Renovate defaults for security updates) and are raised immediately, still gated by the CI build + Chromatic 'UI Tests' check. Automerge follows the same update-type policy as everything else: patch/minor land unattended; a security *major* still lands by hand via the major rule above. Requires GitHub 'Dependabot alerts' enabled on the repo, otherwise no security updates are detected.
